# Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English (LDOCE)

> > The leading online English learner's dictionary providing comprehensive definitions, collocations, and interactive vocabulary practice.

LDOCE is published by Pearson and serves as a premier resource for English language learners worldwide. The dictionary includes extensive coverage of collocations, example sentences from authentic sources like the Financial Times and Wall Street Journal, and interactive quizzes to reinforce vocabulary acquisition.
